scene: Babel BB-9 after battle — complete first draft

source.version_difference: CN has 176 physical lines; EN has 177 because of one additional terminal newline. Both contain 87 text-bearing positions (53 named, 34 narration) at identical physical source lines and with the same type sequence. The 89 non-text control-command lines match exactly. Speaker labels are localized. No inline markup tags occur in text payloads. CN is primary for meaning; EN is used to cross-check names, structure and context.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 浮萍 denotes duckweed/floating plants; CN says there is neither a boat nor floating vegetation.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Передано как «ни лодки, ни даже ряски», сохраняя конкретный образ CN.
semantic_differences.resolution: CN is primary; EN confirms the crossing context.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 历史的局限性 points to the limitations of the people's historical outlook/conditions.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN paraphrases this as limitations imposed by history.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Передано как «ограниченность исторического взгляда», без добавления отдельной причины.
semantic_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN idea while using natural Russian.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 权限 means authority/permissions/access rights to the crown.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN says 'permission', which is less explicit about access authority.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Использовано «права доступа к короне», чтобы передать смысл полномочий, а не обычного разрешения.
semantic_differences.resolution: CN is primary; EN cross-checks the transfer.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 大部分区域 means most of its regions/areas have been sealed.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN paraphrases this as sealing most of it away.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Сохранён образ запечатанных областей короны; бескрайний поток информации остаётся отдельной частью фразы.
semantic_differences.resolution: Russian follows the more specific CN image.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 存续的秘密 is the secret of continued existence/survival.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN renders it as 'secrets of survival'.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Передано как «тайна сохранения жизни»; формулировка остаётся рабочей до общей редакторской сверки термина 存续.
semantic_differences.resolution: CN is primary; EN confirms the survival sense.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 王冠抽离，又重聚 describes the crown being pulled away and gathering/re-forming again.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN interprets the crown as leaving Theresa and finding another.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Перевод сохраняет последовательность CN: корона отделяется и вновь собирается.
semantic_differences.resolution: CN is primary for the physical image; the surrounding scene supplies the transfer context.

notes: CN and EN were fetched from the attributed Kengxxiao community mirrors at the recorded refs; source Git blob hashes are pinned.
Both sources contain 87 text-bearing positions: 53 named dialogue lines and 34 narration lines. Every text position has the same physical source line and type in CN and EN.
CN contains 176 physical lines; EN contains 177 because of one additional terminal newline.
All 89 non-text control-command lines match exactly. Speaker-tag positions align after normalizing the localized speaker labels.
No inline markup tags occur in the text payloads. No source control command was changed or copied into the translation JSON.
CN is primary for meaning. EN Yostar is used to cross-check names, structure and context.
Documented CN/EN wording distinctions are recorded for 浮萍, 历史的局限性, 权限, 大部分区域, 存续的秘密 and 王冠抽离又重聚.
No full CN or EN game scripts are committed.
Literary review and Yostar Global PC in-game validation have not been performed; this is not a verified game patch.

external_references.claim: The Babel synopsis places the events of BB-9 in the 1094 fall of Babel and describes Theresa's transfer of the black crown/Civilight Eterna to Amiya.
external_references.use: Cross-checks the broad scene context; CN remains primary for the wording.

external_references.claim: Русская Arknights Wiki содержит сюжетный контекст Babel и русские формы имён.
external_references.use: Secondary terminology and plot-context reference; not used to override CN text.
